title: God Works for Those Who Wait for Him
story:
A farmer planted seeds in a field at the beginning of the season.

Every morning, he checked the soil, but for many days he could not see anything growing.

His young son became impatient and asked, "Why haven't the plants come up yet?"

The farmer smiled and explained that much of the work was happening beneath the soil where they could not see it.

The roots were growing, the seed was changing, and life was beginning even though nothing was visible above the ground.

The boy learned that waiting did not mean that nothing was happening.

Sometimes our lives can feel the same way.

We pray for an answer, a breakthrough, or a change, but days and months may pass without seeing anything happen.

We may wonder whether God has heard us or whether He is doing anything at all.

Isaiah reminds us that no one has seen or heard of a God like Him, who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him.

God's work is often greater than what we can see or understand.

He may be preparing something in ways that are hidden from us, just as a seed grows beneath the soil before it appears above the ground.

Waiting on God does not mean doing nothing. It means trusting His wisdom, remaining faithful, praying, and continuing to walk in His ways while we wait.

God knows what we need, what lies ahead, and what is best for us.

When you cannot see what God is doing, remember that His silence does not mean His absence.

His ways are higher than ours, and His work may be taking place beyond what your eyes can see.

So wait with faith.

Keep praying, keep trusting, and keep walking with God.

At the right time, you may discover that He was working all along.
life_lesson: When you cannot see what God is doing, do not assume that nothing is happening. Wait for Him with faith, trusting that His wisdom and work are greater than what you can see.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You because You are a God who works beyond what I can see or understand.

When I pray and do not see an immediate answer, help me to wait patiently and trust You.

Keep me from becoming discouraged when circumstances do not change as quickly as I expect.

Help me remember that You may be working in ways that are hidden from me.

Give me faith to continue praying, obeying Your Word, and walking faithfully with You while I wait.

When I cannot understand Your plans, help me trust Your wisdom.

Teach me to be patient and to believe that Your timing is always better than mine.

Thank You for caring about me and for working on behalf of those who wait for You.

I place my unanswered prayers and my future into Your hands.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Is there something you have been praying for but have not yet seen an answer to?

Have you become discouraged because you cannot see what God is doing?

How can you continue trusting, praying, and faithfully walking with God while you wait?
verse: Since ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides You, who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him.
